scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter integral-cms build && pnpm --filter @integral-cms/plugins build && pnpm --filter @integral-cms/admin build
scripts.tarball: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter integral-cms pack --pack-destination dist
scripts.dev:astro: pnpm build:packages && CMS_URL=http://localhost:4321 pnpm --parallel --filter integral-cms --filter @integral-cms/plugins --filter @integral-cms/admin --filter example-astro dev
scripts.dev:nuxt: pnpm build:packages && CMS_URL=http://localhost:3000 pnpm --parallel --filter integral-cms --filter @integral-cms/plugins --filter @integral-cms/admin --filter example-nuxt dev
scripts.dev:tanstack: pnpm build:packages && CMS_URL=http://localhost:3100 pnpm --parallel --filter integral-cms --filter @integral-cms/plugins --filter @integral-cms/admin --filter example-tanstack-start dev
scripts.dev:standalone: pnpm build:packages && CMS_URL=http://localhost:3200 pnpm --parallel --filter integral-cms --filter @integral-cms/plugins --filter @integral-cms/admin --filter example-standalone dev
